create_ate_solver: create an Adaptive Tsallis Entropy solver instance with configurable Tsallis parameter p and learning rates
init_solver_variables: initialize solver variables including strategy distributions and pairwise polymatrix games for n players
compute_exploitability_gradients: compute exploitability gradients with respect to strategy distributions and auxiliary payoff matrices
run_mirror_descent_update: run entropic mirror descent step to update strategy distributions and auxiliary variables
run_euclidean_descent_update: run projected Euclidean gradient descent step to update strategy distributions and auxiliary variables
